            writer.Write((int)context.Bytes2.Length / 2);
            writer.Write(0); // sizeBlockCompressedSizesBytes

            // Build the body (Bytes1+2+4+8 || strings || types || trailer-if-no-blobs)
            // in memory so we can LZ4-compress it before writing to the resource
            // stream. WriteData was previously called with the resource's writer
            // directly; we now hand it a BinaryWriter over a MemoryStream.
            int countTypes;
            int sizeUncompressed;
            int sizeCompressed;

            using (var bodyStream = new MemoryStream())
            {
                using (var bodyWriter = new BinaryWriter(bodyStream, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, leaveOpen: true))
                {
                    countTypes = WriteData(bodyWriter, context);

                    // If there are no binary blobs, the trailer goes inside the
                    // compressed body (matches stock layout). With binary blobs
                    // the trailer is uncompressed at the very end — handled below.
                    if (context.BinaryBlobLengths.Count == 0)
                    {
                        bodyWriter.Write(0xFFEEDD00);
                    }
                }

                sizeUncompressed = (int)bodyStream.Length;

                if (useLz4)
                {
                    // LZ4 single-block compression. The reader at BinaryKV3.cs:331
                    // calls LZ4Codec.Decode(input, output) — the inverse — with
                    // input sized by sizeCompressedTotal in the header.
                    var uncompressedBuffer = bodyStream.GetBuffer();
                    var maxOut = LZ4Codec.MaximumOutputSize(sizeUncompressed);
                    var compressedBuffer = ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(maxOut);
                    try
                    {
                        sizeCompressed = LZ4Codec.Encode(
                            new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(uncompressedBuffer, 0, sizeUncompressed),
                            compressedBuffer.AsSpan(0, maxOut));

                        if (sizeCompressed < 0)
                        {
                            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                $"LZ4 encode failed: input {sizeUncompressed} B, output buffer {maxOut} B.");
                        }

                        writer.Write(compressedBuffer, 0, sizeCompressed);
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(compressedBuffer);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    // Uncompressed — write body verbatim; sizeCompressed == sizeUncompressed.
                    bodyStream.Position = 0;
                    bodyStream.CopyTo(stream);
                    sizeCompressed = sizeUncompressed;
                }
            }

            // Patch the placeholder sizes in the header.
            var endOfCompressedBody = stream.Position;
            stream.Position = countTypesOffset;
            writer.Write(countTypes);
            stream.Position = sizeUncompressedTotalOffset;
            writer.Write(sizeUncompressed);
            writer.Write(sizeCompressed);
            stream.Position = endOfCompressedBody;

            if (context.BinaryBlobLengths.Count > 0)
            {
                // Binary blobs stay uncompressed at the tail of the resource,
                // matching pre-patch behavior. Only the body buffer is LZ4.
                context.BinaryBlobs.WriteTo(writer.BaseStream);

                // Finish with a trailer after binary blobs
